explanation: Requested point (eta, W=1.45 GeV, Q2=0.4 GeV^2, cos theta*=0.1, phi*=30 deg) is physically impossible: the e p -> e' p eta threshold is W >= 1.4861 GeV, so W=1.45 GeV is below production threshold for this channel. Note this is not the same threshold as pion production (which does clear above the Delta resonance) -- the eta's larger mass pushes its threshold higher. The EXCLURAD lookup table also only covers W >= 1.4856 GeV, consistent with this physical limit, so no input file was generated. To proceed, raise W to at least 1.4961 GeV (a safe margin above threshold) at the same Q2, cos theta*, and phi*, or confirm whether the pion channel was intended instead.
